run_auto_generate_examples: run the script to process README.md files from Jupyter notebooks and generate MDX example files
process_readme_files: process README.md files generated from Jupyter notebooks in the sagemaker-sdk directory
process_file: process a single markdown file by transforming markdown blocks and replacing relative paths with GitHub URLs
transform_notebook_comments: transform HTML comment blocks from Jupyter notebooks into Tip components while preserving metadata
replace_relative_paths: replace relative image and link paths with absolute GitHub URLs in processed markdown content
